### Casting Doubt
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-october-3-2026.html
Passage: Genesis 3:1
Points:
- Satan actively searches for ways to twist God's words to fit his destructive agenda.
- In the garden, the serpent turned God’s generous permission into a restrictive prohibition to make Eve doubt His goodness.
- The enemy's subtle tactic begins with planting questions rather than outright denials of what God said.
- Satan used this same strategy of misquoting Scripture out of context when tempting Jesus in the wilderness.
- Hiding God’s Word deeply in our hearts is the essential safeguard against the enemy's deceptions.

### Sin’s Consequences
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/sins-consequences
Passage: Genesis 3:6
Points:
- The choice to eat the forbidden fruit marked the entry of depravity into the human story.
- Yielding to temptation shattered mankind's original innocence and unhindered fellowship with God.
- Sin damaged human faculties, clouding the mind, hardening the heart against God, and corrupting the will.
- This inherited fallen nature continues today, causing people to fight God's truth and follow self-centered desires.
- Fallen human nature reflexively rationalizes failure and blames others instead of honestly confessing sin.
